_doc: Kill streak rewards (GDD 8). Kills made by streak rewards don't count toward the next streak.

rewards.name: Scrying Orb
rewards.desc: Every enemy shows on your team's minimap for 30 s.

rewards.name: Meteor Strike
rewards.desc: Click a tile: a 5x5 meteor lands after a 3-tick warning.

rewards.name: Summoned Guardian
rewards.desc: A guardian fights beside you for 45 s.
